newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel says 30 pct discount for business.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel says 30 pct discount for business.

text.p: Mexican phone company Avantel will offer a discount of up to 30 percent on long-distance calls for business users, the company said on Thursday.

"Avantel...offers...discounts on volume...including an additional discount of 30 percent on domestic and international long-distance calls for whoever bills more than 500 pesos per month," an Avantel news release said.

Avantel, a joint venture between MCI Communications Corp. and the Banamex-Accival financial group, will enter Mexico's long-distance telephone market in full when Telefonos de Mexico's monopoly over residential clients ends on January 1, 1997.
Avantel had previously announced that it would charge a flat rate national long-distance charge of two pesos per minute by day and one peso after 7 p.m. for residential customers.
